note: The official ASVAB raw-to-standard-score conversion tables are not published. Everything here is a documented approximation built on the published STRUCTURE of the test: standard scores with mean 50 and standard deviation 10, VE derived from WK and PC, AFQT = 2VE + AR + MK. Every number the app shows is labelled an estimate.

standard_score.note: Percent correct mapped linearly onto the 20-80 band, so half right lands on the mean. Deliberately simple: an invented S-curve would look more sophisticated without being better justified.

ve.note: VE is a derived verbal score, not a plain sum of WK and PC. The real test converts a weighted raw score through its own table. This is a table-driven approximation: WK carries more weight because it contributes more items on every published format.

afqt.note: The four terms are correlated, so the composite spreads wider than independent terms would give. 37 is a working value, not a published one.

branch_minimums.note: Minimum AFQT to be considered. These move, and a waiver or a particular contract can change what is actually required. The GED figures are much higher than the diploma figures, which is why the two are shown separately rather than as one number. Take real scores to a recruiter.
